note: Chequamegon-Nicolet NF (Lakewood-Laona district) campground among hemlocks on the west shore of 1,667-acre Pine Lake, between Crandon and Three Lakes; paved boat landing with two docks (no landing fee for campers) and a picnic area. ATVs, UTVs and golf carts may not be ridden in the campground. Not the private Hiles-Pine Lake Campground. --Claude
